name: IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_H
description: IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_H stores historical snapshots of payment instructions. This table contains denormalized versions of payment instructions from specific points in time, including when the payment instruction was submitted to a payment system. Different snapshots of the same payment instruction can exist in this table. These snapshots are differentiated by the table's primary key and a snapshot date.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Payment instruction identifier

columns.name: PMT_INSTRUCTION_HISTORY_DATE
columns.description: Payment instruction date

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_NAME
columns.description: Payment instruction name

columns.name: PAYMENT_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format used for the payment file.

columns.name: BILL_PAYABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating whether a payment file consists of bills payable.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: Payment system that the payment file or positive pay file is transmitted to

columns.name: PRINT_INSTRUCTION_IMMED_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating if the payment file will be printed immediately after formatting, or will wait for user input before initiating printing.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_INSTR_IMMED_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag indicating if the payment file will be transmitted immediately after formatting, or will wait for user input to initate transmission.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_CONFIGURATION_ID
columns.description: Transmission configuration identifier

columns.name: SECURITY_CONFIGURATION_ID
columns.description: Security configuration Identifier from the payment process profile

columns.name: POSITIVE_PAY_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Code for the format that is used to create a positive pay file for the payment file.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the process by which payments are built into payment files. Values taken from lookup: IBY_PROCESS_TYPES which include STANDARD for payments processed as part of a payment process request, IMMEDIATE for single payments,, and MANUAL for manual payments which are recorded but not processed by Oracle Payments.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_STATUS
columns.description: Payment file status. Values taken from lookup IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTION_STATUSES.

columns.name: PAYMENTS_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N flag that indicates if the payments are complete

columns.name: INT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ROUTING_NUM
columns.description: Internal bank account routing number from CE bank accounts

columns.name: INT_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal bank account number from CE bank accounts

columns.name: INT_BANK_ACCOUNT_IBAN_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal bank account IBAN number from CE bank accounts

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence number assigned to the payment file.

columns.name: PAY_ADMIN_ASSIGNED_REF_CODE
columns.description: Administrator-assigned reference code

columns.name: PAYMENT_COUNT
columns.description: Number of payments comprising this payment file.

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_DATE
columns.description: Date that the payment file is transmitted to the payment system.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the acknowledgment is received

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Notes entered by the user while submitting Create Payment Files process.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_ADVICE_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether any separate remittance advice documents were created for the payment file. By default, set to No.

columns.name: BANK_ASSIGNED_REF_CODE
columns.description: Payment system-provided reference code for this payment file

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier of the payment file. Populated only when first party legal entity is specified as a grouping rule for payment file creation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS, and others.

columns.name: PRINTER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the printer where the payment file will be printed.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Payment reason that was used to limit the the payment file creation to a single payment reason.  Populated only when payment reason is specified as a grouping rule.
